Asia/Kolkata = +5:30, Europe/London in 1585 would have been using local mean time (no standard time zones yet), but for this exercise, treat London as UTC+0 (as per reference rule).  

Source time: 21:00 (April 10)  
Source offset: +5:30  
Target offset: 0  

target_time = 21:00 + (0 − 5:30) = 21:00 − 5:30 = 15:30 same day.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 15:30
